definitions.gloss: powerful nation; great power; major power
definitions.explanation: A country with significant military, economic, and political influence in international affairs.

examples.japanese: アメリカは{世界|せかい}の{強大国|きょうだいこく}だ。
{強大国|きょうだいこく}の{間|あいだ}で{緊張|きんちょう}が{高|たか}まっている。
examples.english: Tensions are rising among the great powers.

examples.japanese: {歴史的|れきしてき}に{見|み}ると、{強大国|きょうだいこく}の{興亡|こうぼう}は{国際秩序|こくさいちつじょ}の{変化|へんか}と{密接|みっせつ}に{結|むす}びついている。
examples.english: Historically, the rise and fall of great powers is closely tied to changes in the international order.

notes:
A compound of {強大|きょうだい} (mighty, powerful) and {国|こく} (country, nation). Used in political science, international relations, and news reporting to describe countries with outsized global influence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{強大国|きょうだいこく}: military superpower
- {経済|けいざい}{強大国|きょうだいこく}: economic powerhouse
- {強大国|きょうだいこく}の{覇権|はけん}: hegemony of great powers
- {強大国|きょうだいこく}の{台頭|たいとう}: rise of a great power

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大国|たいこく}: great power, major nation — the most common and neutral term
- {超大国|ちょうたいこく}: superpower — specifically for nations at the top of global power
- {列強|れっきょう}: the great powers — historically, the group of dominant colonial/imperial nations
